why_agent_cannot: a wallet connection or signature is required
what_human_must_do: 1 Step 1 : Open the PrismaX operator app Go to the operator app , which is the VLA Foundry portal linked from the PrismaX homepage.
2 Step 2 : Connect a wallet or an email Choose Phantom, MetaMask, OKX Wallet, Coinbase Wallet or WalletConnect, or pick the email option instead.
3 Step 3 : Start validating data Use the Begin Validating button under the prompt to validate data and earn points. The app says validation is now live.
4 Step 4 : Track your Prisma Points Check the All-Time Prisma Points, Daily Prisma Points and Data Hours Contributed counters on the dashboard.

5 Step 5 : Apply as an operator to capture data If you own a robot, apply through the operator data page to run paid teleoperation sessions. Egocentric recording has a waitlist on the PrismaX homepage .
